title: Oscilloscope beam drawings
technique: A simulated oscilloscope tube: one glowing beam traces word outlines, 3D model wireframes and waveforms, with fading phosphor afterglow, soft glow and a measuring grid.
music: The raw left and right audio samples are added to the beam's position, so every drawing shivers and fattens as the track gets louder and is clean when it is quiet. Kicks make the picture swell, ring and brighten, hi-hats fatten the line, shapes change every 4 or 8 beats, and a new section of the song briefly bursts the drawing into scribble.

takes.name: Word
takes.description: A single phrase drawn as a green outline low and off-centre on a grid, dissolving into the raw stereo waveform on every fourth beat before the next phrase forms out of it.

takes.name: Stereo cloud
takes.description: The stereo sound itself fills the frame as an amber cloud on a circular grid, with only a small label word in one corner.

takes.name: Drawing sheet
takes.description: A blue-white wireframe model turns in 3D on one side with its still front and top views small on the other, changing to a new model every 8 beats.
words: A 3D MODEL / TRACED BY THE BEAM
ONE TURNING VIEW / FRONT AND TOP

takes.name: Macro
takes.description: An extreme close-up of a giant letter outline, shown as fat out-of-focus ribbons written by a travelling point with a blue flash and a long yellow afterglow, and no grid.
words: MACRO: ONE LETTER / OUTLINE, VERY CLOSE
A WIDE BEAM / OUT OF FOCUS

takes.name: Arcade board
takes.description: Eight different wireframe models, each in its own colour, spin on a four by two board that reshuffles every bar, like a colour vector arcade screen.

takes.name: Dual trace
takes.description: A classic swept scope view with the left channel's waveform above and the right channel's below, or the two overlaid, plus a small readout word.

takes.name: Knots
takes.description: Four nested looping 3D knot figures shading from amber to red, whose proportions change every 8 beats.
words: SINE WAVES / ON X, Y AND Z

takes.name: Negative wall
takes.description: The picture is inverted: a lit green screen with eight blocks of text cut out of it in black, written in fragments by travelling points.

takes.name: Dial
takes.description: Aqua phrases bent around three concentric rings that tick round one notch per beat in alternating directions, with a small circular waveform at the centre, larger than the frame and pushed to one side.

takes.name: Relief scan
takes.description: Hot pink horizontal scan lines seen at a slant are pushed out of the screen by the brightness of a picture, which is either a lit turning model or a two-line phrase.
words: A RUTT-ETRA SCAN / SEEN AT A SLANT

takes.name: Waterfall
takes.description: A single violet waveform trace climbs away in steps while its long afterglow leaves the last few seconds behind as a ridged landscape, with a small readout word.

as_processor: Redraws the picture with an oscilloscope beam: as 64 glowing scan lines pushed up by its brightness, as a stack of 32 audio waveform traces that are bright where it is bright, or as a slow ridged landscape built one row at a time.
